# exo_irm_configuration (Data Source)

Look up an existing IRMConfiguration object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `automatic_service_update_enabled` (Boolean) Maps to the -AutomaticServiceUpdateEnabled parameter.
- `azure_rms_licensing_enabled` (Boolean) Maps to the -AzureRMSLicensingEnabled parameter.
- `decrypt_attachment_for_encrypt_only` (Boolean) Maps to the -DecryptAttachmentForEncryptOnly parameter.
- `e_discovery_super_user_enabled` (Boolean) Maps to the -EDiscoverySuperUserEnabled parameter.
- `enable_pdf_encryption` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnablePdfEncryption parameter.
- `enable_portal_tracking_logs` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnablePortalTrackingLogs parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `internal_licensing_enabled` (Boolean) Maps to the -InternalLicensingEnabled parameter.
- `journal_report_decryption_enabled` (Boolean) Maps to the -JournalReportDecryptionEnabled parameter.
- `licensing_location` (String) Maps to the -LicensingLocation parameter.
- `reject_if_recipient_has_no_rights` (Boolean) Maps to the -RejectIfRecipientHasNoRights parameter.
- `rms_online_key_sharing_location` (String) Maps to the -RMSOnlineKeySharingLocation parameter.
- `search_enabled` (Boolean) Maps to the -SearchEnabled parameter.
- `simplified_client_access_do_not_forward_disabled` (Boolean) Maps to the -SimplifiedClientAccessDoNotForwardDisabled parameter.
- `simplified_client_access_enabled` (Boolean) Maps to the -SimplifiedClientAccessEnabled parameter.
- `simplified_client_access_encrypt_only_disabled` (Boolean) Maps to the -SimplifiedClientAccessEncryptOnlyDisabled parameter.
- `transport_decryption_setting` (String) Maps to the -TransportDecryptionSetting parameter.
